bagPolicy.summary: TO Live says bags are not allowed at the venue; check the particular event information for exceptions.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: There is no onsite parking except a few spaces for guests with accessible needs. Nearby public lots include Brookfield Place at 181 Bay Street, the Scott Street lot just east, and The Esplanade lot just south, plus limited metered street parking.

rideshare.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general rideshare pickup location for concerts; consult the event instructions.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: All concession stands are cashless. Debit cards, credit cards and other electronic payments are accepted.

accessibility.summary: The operator provides accessibility information for its theatres and advises visitors to check their event-specific needs.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general concert re-entry rule for concerts; consult the event instructions.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is at 1 Front Street East (416-366-7723 or 1-800-708-6754). It's open Monday to Friday, 1 pm to 6 pm, and on show days it opens two hours before the first show and closes half an hour after the last.

gates.summary: The theatre publishes any special admission conditions in the event listing; check those details before travelling.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
